BeReferralIntentOrPrescriptionType

Parameter intent-or-prescription-type:token

Matches ServiceRequests whose intent OR prescriptionType category matches any of the given tokens. Qualify each value with its system: http://hl7.org/fhir/request-intent for intent, https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/terminology/CodeSystem/be-cs-prescription-type for the prescriptionType slice of category. Example: GET [base]/ServiceRequest?intent-or-prescription-type=proposal,telemonitoring-chronic-heart-failure

ResourceServiceRequest
ExpressionServiceRequest.intent | ServiceRequest.category.where(coding.system = 'https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/terminology/CodeSystem/be-cs-prescription-type')
Multiples
  • multipleAnd: The parameter may only appear once
  • multipleOr: The parameter may have multiple values (separated by comma) where at least one must be true
